auditor_red_flag_3y.source: true/false; auditor report + CARO, resignation letters

fund_diversion_red_flag_3y.source: true/false; related-party note: ICDs/loans/advances/guarantees to promoter-group private entities

thesis_assumption_broken.source: optional true/false; name the written assumption that failed

tailwind_evidence.source: list; one evidence line per item (budget doc, policy notification, industry data) with date

change_catalysts.source: list; each item dated within 24 months (filing / concall / news URL)

order_book_to_ttm_sales.source: optional; order book (filing/concall, date) / TTM sales. Leave null for non-order businesses

capital_allocation_checks.source: list; related-party note, investments schedule, shareholding/equity history

transparency_checks.source: list; e.g. date of e-mail reply, concall transcript URL

guidance_hit_pct.source: number or "none_stated"; list each target, window and outcome

reputation_checks.source: list; who vouched (role, not name), litigation search, succession disclosure

monetisable_assets_cover_debt.source: optional true/false; land/investments with valuation >= borrowings

ground_checks.source: list; date and who/where for each check
